name: harry18456
description: Harry's personal Claude Code plugins — notifications, usage insights, local image generation, and small workflow tools.

plugins.name: hook-notify
plugins.description: Windows-native toast + sound notifications for Claude Code Stop / Notification events.

plugins.name: cowork-insights
plugins.description: Cowork-only usage report for Claude Desktop — sessions, tokens (incl. prompt cache), models, tools. Full history with no 30-day limit, read-only.

plugins.name: agy-image
plugins.description: Generate or edit images locally via the agy CLI (Antigravity / Gemini Nano Banana) — no API key — with true transparent backgrounds via local rembg.

plugins.name: codex-image
plugins.description: Generate or edit images by driving the OpenAI Codex CLI's built-in image_gen tool (gpt-image-2) — ChatGPT subscription login, no API key — with exact sizes and true transparent backgrounds via local rembg. Cross-platform.

plugins.name: spec-orchestrate
plugins.description: Spec-driven development orchestrated entirely by Claude Code, autonomously from propose to commit — hybrid execution (main thread or one executor subagent per change), per-stage review gates, runtime verification, archive and selective commit; stops only on real blockers. Auto-detects spectra or openspec.

plugins.name: adhd-ste100-eli5
plugins.description: An output style that makes Claude Code answers cheap to read and cheap to act on. Three non-overlapping layers: message shape from ADHD support practice (action first, numbered steps, state restated every turn), sentence mechanics from the ASD-STE100 controlled-English standard (one instruction per sentence, capped length, active voice), word choice from ELI5 (plainest word, jargon explained in the same breath). Language-neutral.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Turn a project into evidence-tagged Markdown knowledge. doc-mine interviews you first (what you know, what you want, what you assume but never checked), then mines the source into categorized docs/ where every sentence cites file:line, an official URL, or an actual run — gaps are marked [UNVERIFIED] instead of guessed. doc-distill condenses it all into one self-contained file you can hand to anyone.

plugins.name: qrcode
plugins.description: Design, build and verify QR codes that are guaranteed to scan — logo in the middle, brand colors or gradients, dot/rounded/leaf modules, custom finders, cards with text — for print or screens. A deterministic engine picks EC level, version, mask and logo size, then gates every design on per-block error budget, structure, contrast, two decoders and robustness sweeps. Cross-platform: runs with uv or a plain Python 3.12-3.14, no system libraries.
